title: Recovered ChatGPT Context — High-Value Under-Promoted Structures
status: recovered-context inventory; mixed canon, user-stated framework, prior synthesis and provisional interpretation
purpose: Promote high-value structures recovered from prior ChatGPT conversations that were not yet clearly owned by canonical repository records. This file is not itself final canon; it routes each recovery item to the appropriate owner and preserves uncertainty where primary dated evidence is absent.
recovery_rule: Recovered conversation material can preserve project development, exact formulations and interpretive architecture, but it must not be silently upgraded into independently verified historical fact. Primary posts, books, files and external sources outrank conversational reconstruction when they conflict.
